ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low global contrast ratio; approximately 92% low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixels vs 8% high-intensity (white/tan) pixels localized primarily at the margins and as discrete rings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominant dark base with high-intensity contiguous clusters localized at the distal margins (trailing edge); secondary distribution of 15+ high-intensity annular rings scattered across the mid-region of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central indentation; interior angle estimated at 40 degrees; notch apex clearly defined at the central vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extreme serration profile; high-frequency irregularities with peak amplitudes of 5-15 pixels caused by dense clusters of calcified organisms protruding from the natural tissue boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve from the median notch to the distal tips; steep upward sweep on the lateral margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Confirmed presence of multiple circular high-contrast annuli (white rings on black background) distributed across the central and outer regions of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive localized bio-fouling (barnacle colonization) along the entire trailing edge and lobe tips; presence of multiple detached-barnacle ring scars across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive white-ringed scar constellations localized on the central dark regions of the lobes.
